identity.name: SkillHub
identity.one_liner: Self-hosted open-source registry for publishing, versioning, and governing enterprise agent skills.
identity.short_description: SkillHub is an open-source agent skill registry for enterprises. It focuses on publishing and versioning skill packages, governance with RBAC and audit logs, and self-hosted deployment with Docker or Kubernetes.

positioning.why_it_matters: As teams create more agent skills, they need registries, ownership, versioning, and governance. SkillHub treats skills as managed artifacts rather than loose prompt files.
best_for: Enterprise teams building shared agent skill libraries
Platform teams that need RBAC and audit logs for skills
Organizations deploying skills on-premise or in controlled environments
not_for: Solo users with only a few local skills
Teams looking for a single-purpose skill rather than a registry

core_strengths.title: Skill registry
core_strengths.description: SkillHub provides a place to publish and version agent skill packages.
core_strengths.why_it_matters: Shared skills become easier to discover, review, and maintain when they live in a registry.

core_strengths.title: Governance controls
core_strengths.description: The project emphasizes RBAC and audit logs.
core_strengths.why_it_matters: Enterprise agent skills need ownership, permissions, and traceability.

core_strengths.title: Self-hosted deployment
core_strengths.description: SkillHub is designed for on-premise deployment with Docker or Kubernetes.
core_strengths.why_it_matters: Teams can manage skills without handing internal workflow definitions to a hosted platform.

seo_article.intro: SkillHub is a self-hosted registry for enterprise agent skills.
seo_article.what_it_is: It helps teams publish, version, govern, and deploy reusable skill packages.
seo_article.why_it_matters: Agent skills are becoming shared software artifacts, and shared artifacts need governance.
seo_article.how_it_works: Evaluate it by publishing a small skill library, assigning ownership, and testing update and audit workflows.

faq.question: Is SkillHub open source?
faq.answer: Yes. The GitHub repository is listed under the Apache-2.0 license.

faq.question: Who should evaluate SkillHub?
faq.answer: Teams managing shared agent skills across departments or controlled environments should evaluate it.
